scope: Fresh canonical reconciliation after an own native Vault transaction reverted and its still-valid EIP3009 authorization was consumed later.
changes: Pin the latest token/domain/proxy and Selection/Vault deployment before current marker reads.
Read token authorizationState and Vault usedIncomeAuthorization at the same canonical block hash.
Recheck latest/receipt hashes, head and chain before returning definitive reverted; refuse consumed authorization as reconciliation_required.
Retain the original signed raw bytes/hash and never adopt another relay transaction or return cached failed-payment evidence.
regressions: Actual own low-gas canonical revert followed by direct-token consumption of the original still-valid signature.
Actual own low-gas canonical revert followed by successful alternate-relay native Vault ingress with original-payer income classification.
Both cases exercise cached reverted X402PaymentService retries and prove reconciliation refusal with the original journal/hash unchanged.
review: Separate read-only component review found no further actionable issue in the native diff; this is not an independent external security audit.

linux.status: Not claimed by this Windows evidence; a subsequent exact-commit SDK/native Linux acceptance is recorded separately.

The existing 50-case native and c4f71bf 190-case Linux acceptances retain their historical source boundaries.
